prior_summary: Learned two-frame causal GRU contact belief conditions an action DDPM. Finger aperture, TCP-object relative rotations/translations and backward co-motion support six soft manipulation modes plus independent red/blue support predictions. Learned transitions encourage persistence without a scripted controller. Event-weighted gripper denoising and trainable short-horizon action-conditioned attachment/co-motion forecasts supervise the full red-buffer-to-blue-acquisition slice.
applicable_conditions: World-frame 47D state for the same position-controlled Panda, two 0.04 m blocks and parallel fingers. Requires two actual recent observations at 0.05 s spacing, including qpos/qvel and TCP/red/blue poses. Appropriate from open home through red pickup, red buffer descent/release, empty retreat, blue approach/closing and initial blue lift, including entry partway through the shared transition. No attachment state is assumed at entry.
termination_guidance: The useful exit combines red supported in the free buffer with blue rising close to TCP, near-preserved TCP-blue relation and held-width fingers. Closed intent alone or red buffer position alone is insufficient manipulation-readiness evidence. Preserve the learned closed blue grasp across handoff and pass actual recent states to transfer_blue; a stopped arm is not required. These are invocation cues, not extra task-success requirements.
limitations: Successful demonstrations provide contact proxies, not force/contact truth or recovery coverage. Only two causal frames are available, so the GRU is reinitialized from observed features for each window and does not implement persistent cross-invocation memory. Future lift labels have limited lookahead and can blur the closing/attached boundary. Auxiliary learned dynamics is not IK, physics enforcement or evidence of delay/slip robustness. Timing robustness and event-accuracy improvement remain untested.

config.relative_translation_scale: sum of supplied complete-demo TCP and corresponding object coordinate half ranges
config.gripper_event_weight: 1 + 3 times sign-change-neighborhood + 1.5 times closing-proxy + releasing-proxy; sign neighborhood has five action slots
config.diffusion_loss: (7 * masked arm mean squared epsilon error + 2 * event-weighted gripper mean squared epsilon error) / 9
config.forecast_loss: Smooth L1 on six relative translation changes, six object translations and two normalized fingers, plus 0.25 times attachment BCE; estimated-action branch weighted by alpha_bar and uses x0 clipped to [-2,2]
config.training_recipe: Fixed assignment: 20000 updates, batch 128, AdamW 1e-4 and weight decay 1e-6, 500 warmup, cosine schedule, norm clip 1, EMA 0.999, seed 0; last EMA only
config.diffusion_recipe: Fixed epsilon DDPM, 100 train and sampling steps, horizon 16, execute 8, clip_sample true; absolute joint and learned gripper commands
config.segmentation: All assigned expanded slices, starting at 0 and ending at 490,487,483,488,481,480,484,493,482,486,489,485 for demo10100 through demo10111 respectively; no phase filtering or sample exclusion
